papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification of Turbulence Model Closure Coefficients for Transonic Wall-Bounded Flows
papers.abstract: The goal of this work was to quantify the uncertainty and sensitivity of commonly used turbulence models in Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes codes due to uncertainty in the values of closure coefficients for transonic, wall-bounded flows and to rank the contribution of each coefficient to uncertainty in various output flow quantities of interest. Specifically, uncertainty quantification of turbulence model closure coefficients was performed for transonic flow over an axisymmetric bump at zero degrees angle of attack and the RAE 2822 transonic airfoil at a lift coefficient of 0.744. Three turbulence models were considered: the Spalart-Allmaras Model, Wilcox (2006) k-w Model, and the Menter Shear-Stress Trans- port Model. The FUN3D code developed by NASA Langley Research Center was used as the flow solver. The uncertainty quantification analysis employed stochastic expansions based on non-intrusive polynomial chaos as an efficient means of uncertainty propagation. Several integrated and point-quantities are considered as uncertain outputs for both CFD problems. All closure coefficients were treated as epistemic uncertain variables represented with intervals. Sobol indices were used to rank the relative contributions of each closure coefficient to the total uncertainty in the output quantities of interest. This study identified a number of closure coefficients for each turbulence model for which more information will reduce the amount of uncertainty in the output significantly for transonic, wall-bounded flows.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文针对湍流模型系数的不确定性量化，与生物力学植入物设计的代理建模无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on CFD turbulence model UQ for transonic flows, not on FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics or structural optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 量化跨声速壁面流动中湍流模型闭合系数的不确定性
summary_zh.method: 采用非侵入式多项式混沌展开传播不确定性，并计算Sobol指数进行敏感性分析
summary_zh.result: 识别出对输出不确定性贡献最大的闭合系数
summary_zh.validation: 在轴对称凸起和RAE 2822翼型两个算例上验证

summary_en.motivation: To quantify the uncertainty and sensitivity of turbulence model closure coefficients in transonic wall-bounded flows.
summary_en.method: Non-intrusive polynomial chaos expansions were used to propagate epistemic uncertainties in closure coefficients, with Sobol indices for sensitivity ranking.
summary_en.result: Key closure coefficients were identified that significantly influence output uncertainty for the considered transonic flows.
summary_en.validation: Validated on two benchmark CFD problems: axisymmetric bump and RAE 2822 airfoil.

papers.title: Microstructure, mechanical behavior, and wear properties of FeCrMoVC steel prepared by selective laser melting and casting
papers.first_author_affiliation: IFW Dresden, Institute for Complex Materials, P.O. Box 27 01 16, D-01171 Dresden, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: J. Sander
corresponding_authors.affiliation: IFW Dresden, Institute for Complex Materials, P.O. Box 27 01 16, D-01171 Dresden, Germany

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究FeCrMoVC钢的SLM工艺，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或生物医学植入物。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure, no stress shielding analysis, no biomedical implant context, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制备FeCrMoVC钢的微观结构与性能
summary_zh.method: 对比SLM与铸造FeCrMoVC钢的微观组织、力学及磨损性能
summary_zh.result: SLM试样具有更细的微观组织和更高的硬度与耐磨性
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微组织观察、力学测试和磨损实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the microstructure and mechanical properties of FeCrMoVC steel fabricated by selective laser melting compared to casting.
summary_en.method: FeCrMoVC steel samples were prepared by SLM and casting, and their microstructure, mechanical behavior, and wear properties were characterized.
summary_en.result: SLM-processed steel exhibited finer microstructure, higher hardness, and superior wear resistance relative to cast counterparts.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through microstructural analysis, mechanical testing, and wear experiments.
